title: Grisaia no Rakuen: Grisaia no Tokuten
justification: AniList 21415 (SPECIAL, 5 episode(s) from 2015-08-26) is AniDB 11009's special(s) S1-S5, aired 2015-08-26 to 2015-12-25. AniList's PARENT relation names AniList 21006, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 11009, and AniDB lists MAL 31368 on AniDB 11009. The parent's row (start 1, end 5, offset 8) places them on TVDB 281949 0x9-0x13, whose titles and dates agree within a day.
